CO: Name and address of successful supplier, contractor or service provider: 
    Grahams Engineering Ltd.
    NSG Environmental Ltd.
AB: CPV: 28216100, 40530000, 28811200.
    Supply of 500-litre drums for Remote-handled Intermediate Level Waste.
    Supply of 500-litre drums on a call off basis for remote-handled 
    intermediate level waste. The nature of the wastes is such that it is 
    necessary to have a lining of cementitious grout, on the inside of the 
    drum, to act as a barrier between the wastes and the outer skin of the 
    drum. UKAEA have opted to have separate contracts for supply of drums and 
    supply of the grouted lining.
    Iron or steel drums.
    Radioactive materials.
    Cement.
TX: CONTRACT AWARD NOTICE
    Supplies
    This contract is covered by the Government Procurement Agreement (GPA): 
    Yes.
    SECTION I: CONTRACTING AUTHORITY
    I.1)  Official name and address of the contracting authority: United 
    Kingdom Atomic Energy Authority, Harwell Commercial Dept, Att: Sam Dancy, 
    B152, Harwell International Business Centre, UK-Didcot OX11 0RA. Tel.: 
    01235 436833. Fax: 01235 4324413. E-mail: teresa.lee@ukaea.org.uk.
    I.2)  Type of contracting authority: Central level.
    SECTION II: OBJECT OF THE CONTRACT
    II.1)  Type of contract: Supplies.
    II.2)  Framework agreement: No.
    II.3)  Nomenclature
    II.3.1)  Common Procurement Vocabulary (CPV): 28216100, 40530000, 
    28811200.
    II.4)  Title attributed to the contract by the contracting authority: 
    Supply of 500-litre drums for Remote-handled Intermediate Level Waste.
    II.5)  Short description: Supply of 500-litre drums on a call off basis 
    for remote-handled intermediate level waste. The nature of the wastes is 
    such that it is necessary to have a lining of cementitious grout, on the 
    inside of the drum, to act as a barrier between the wastes and the outer 
    skin of the drum. UKAEA have opted to have separate contracts for supply 
    of drums and supply of the grouted lining.
    Iron or steel drums.
    Radioactive materials.
    Cement.
    SECTION IV: PROCEDURE
    IV.1)  Type of procedure: Restricted.
    IV.2)  Award criteria: The most economically advantageous tender in terms 
    of:
    technical expertise particularly with welding and grout infilling as 
    appropriate;
    experience of high volume manufacturing in the same product field;
    manufacturing time;
    value for money.
